(carried from run-73, new there from U343q) scripts/orchestrator/acp-broker:429-430, :1680-1681: the slot docstring and the slot comment say a pre-existing entry at the slot's name "is never taken" and that "an entry that is not this connection's stays". That is true for a non-empty directory, a file and a link, but not for an empty directory: when the mkdir fails because one stands at the name, a signal during the failed mkdir or the refuse it runs (:1692, :409-416) makes the rmdir take it (probe, artifact agents/parent-hunter/artifacts/rmdir-trap-probe.txt). Only the broker's own user can make an entry in `<seats-root>/.state` (no seat's write roots include it, scripts/orchestrator/hcom-seat:2275), and the name carries the second and the pid, so no boundary is crossed. Smallest fix: correct the two comments to say that an empty directory already standing at the name may be taken. A marker set in the mkdir's failure branch would not close it: that assignment is again a command after the mkdir, the same two-step split verdict U343p-901e096a P1 :1669 names. If the claim is wanted, refuse before arming the trap when path_presence finds an entry at the name (:371-383), which leaves only a same-user plant racing that check.
